note: Subject layer (layer 5) for the UNDEAD faction, copied from the approved subject lines in docs/art/factions/UNDEAD.md. Keys are runtime art subjects from src/assets/chibi-art-v7.ts: UNIT:UNDEAD:<ROLE> is the Undead unit of that mechanical role (Patrol Boat and Battleship reuse the Human art), and GRAVE is the unowned Grave marker. Batch 5 (pulp_wars-67q.11) adds PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:<ROLE> portraits and the Undead command icons (ICON:ACTION:UNDEAD:RALLY is Frenzy). The /BONE, /VIOLET and /CALM keys (bead pulp_wars-3tq.12) are the subject lines of the new visual direction: fixed faction colours with no owner area (pale bone, near-black cloth, pallid ash grey flesh, one violet accent); batch direction-undead uses them.

subjects.IMPROVEMENT:UNDEAD:FARM/RICH: Subject: a tiny spooky graveyard, six things well apart: at the back a small pale stone mausoleum with a peaked roof and dark arched door, and a bare dead tree with a raven on a branch; in front a leaning stone cross, a round-topped headstone, a cracked slab, and a short lantern post with a glowing violet flame. All stone is pale blue-grey (#aab2c2), darker on the right; a wisp of mist; dark slate outline. The group is small, with a wide empty margin all round.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:UNDEAD:WINDMILL: Subject: a spooky old windmill: one round tower of dark slate-grey stone with a small dark door and one small glowing violet window, a near-black charcoal cone roof, and four big sail arms of dark wood with ragged torn charcoal-grey cloth full of holes, set in a big X on the front and wider than the tower; a few pale ivory bones leaning at its foot; no fence, no field. Buildings only.
subjects.UNIT:UNDEAD:SUBMARINE: Subject: Submarine of the Undead, a chunky cute small drowned ghost galley seen from the front-right, long and very low with no mast and no sail, a sunken wreck that sails again: a low closed near-black charcoal wooden hull crusted with pale grey barnacles, a pale ivory bone rail, a big pale ivory skull figurehead on the bow, a low humped black deck cabin with two round portholes glowing bright violet, and one small lantern glowing bright violet on a short crooked pole; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:SUBMARINE: Subject: Submarine of the Undead, a chunky cute small drowned ghost galley shown whole from the front-right: a low closed near-black hull crusted with pale grey barnacles, a pale ivory bone rail and a skull figurehead, a low humped black cabin with two round portholes glowing bright violet, a small violet lantern; no mast, no sail, no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:UNDEAD:SWORDSMAN/BONE: Subject: Wight, a chunky cute armoured barrow-king risen from his own grave, with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a short broad sturdy body, heavier and wider than a skeleton soldier: a closed weathered grey iron great helm with rust patches that hides the whole face, with two glowing bright violet eye slits and a spiky tarnished bronze crown on top, a weathered grey iron breastplate and two big round iron pauldrons with tarnished bronze rims, a dark iron chainmail skirt with a thin bright violet hem, pale ivory bone hands and bone feet, no shield at all, and one huge notched two-handed greataxe with a broad light grey iron blade held up beside his head; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a heavy armoured grave-king with a great axe, neither the bare-boned Skeleton with his sword and shield nor the robed Lich with his orb.
subjects.PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:SWORDSMAN/BONE: Subject: Wight portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute armoured barrow-king: a huge closed weathered grey iron great helm with rust patches that hides the whole face, with two glowing bright violet eye slits and a spiky tarnished bronze crown on top, two big round iron pauldrons with tarnished bronze rims, and the broad light grey iron blade of a notched greataxe raised beside the helm; no skull face shows, no shield and no sword.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:UNDEAD:LUMBER_CAMP: Subject: a spooky woodcutters' camp: at the back two bare dead trees of pale ashen grey bark with clawed branches; in front a neat stack of pale grey dead logs showing round ends, a broken stump with a rusty iron axe stuck in it, and a tiny lean-to of ragged charcoal cloth on pale bone poles with one small violet lantern. Ash greys, ivory bone, charcoal, a little violet; no green, no brown; dark slate outline. Compact, with an empty margin all round.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:UNDEAD:SAWMILL: Subject: a spooky bone sawmill, no trees: one small crooked shed of dark slate planks with a near-black peaked roof and one glowing violet window; at its front one big round saw blade of pale ivory bone with jagged teeth standing upright in a low bench, a pale grey log lying on the bench; beside it a stack of three ashen grey logs and a pile of pale planks. Slate, charcoal, ivory bone, a little violet; no green; dark slate outline. Compact, with an empty margin all round.
